engines._comment: VS-13 S1.1 (2026-05-04, PR #74+#75+#76 review): we target Node 22 for the VS-13 stack jump. Inside the Node 22 branch, jsdom 29 (full range `^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24.0.0`) requires ≥22.13, and Vite 8 / Rolldown (full range `^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0`) require ≥22.12. The binding constraint for our Node-22 target is therefore 22.13. (Node 20.19+ and 24+ are still supported by these deps; we just chose 22 as our target — see VS-13 S1.0 PR #73.) With `engine-strict=true` in .npmrc, npm install fails outright if local Node is below the declared floor.

_note: v0.3 (VS-13 S1.1, 2026-05-04): frontend stack jumped 5 majors — react 18→19 / vite 5→8 / typescript 5.6→6 / vitest 2→4 / @testing-library 16.0→16.3.2 / recharts 2→3 / react-router 6→7. Node floor 22.13.0 (jsdom 29 binding). CesiumJS lands in VS-13 S2 (separate PR). Material Design / k8s-Dashboard aesthetic preserved (MUI 6 unchanged). README.md in this directory is the source of truth for stack + run; CLAUDE.md and PROJECT_STATUS.md are repo-level.
